is.t: In a uniform distribution, all values between the lower bound and upper bound are equally likely. No values outside of the minimum and maximum are possible. The uniform distribution is symmetrical, i.e., the mean is halfway between the upper and lower bounds of the 90% confidence interval. Use the formula in "Random Value Generator" to generate a random value from within this distribution.
The histogram is the distribution based on the 10,000 random scenarios from this worksheet.
The "sparklines" are a quick way to visualize the cumulative % and inverse cumulative % curves, respectively.
To recalculate manually -- i.e., to generate 10,000 new random scenarios -- press F9.
Use for validation and cross- checking
